rows.notes: This is a chain. I set the online ordering menu to this store (Westown Parkway, 1146) and read the prices for this location from each item page on 2026-10-11. I extracted 202 product pages. A few items repeat across sections, such as gallon teas, breadsticks and catering pans that are identical to the Family-Size Pans. I collapsed most of those repeats rather than listing them twice. Descriptions are shortened from the source text. The vegetarian tag is applied only where the menu marks (V). I gave no gluten-free tags: the menu's own disclaimer says its kitchens are not free of gluten and it cannot ensure gluten-free, even for the Gluten Sensitive section. The ordering site is a JS app with no stable per-location menu URL, so menu_url is the generic /menu, which shows this store's prices once the location is selected.
